name: ⚽ Blade League
desc:
⚡ Blade League is a fast-paced, team-based game where strategy and skill are key. Work with your team—whether 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4—to score goals and outplay your opponents. First team to 6 wins!

🔥 Unlock unique abilities to match your playstyle. Boost your speed, power, or precision to gain the edge in every match.

🎯 Customize your experience with unique sword skins, flashy goal effects, emotes, and more to stand out on the field.

🏆 Shoot for the leaderboard or play casually! The choice is yours.

⚠️This game is in BETA, please report any bugs you come across in our community server
